tool_input.command:
mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/version-scheme.md <<'EOF'
# Version Numbering Scheme

This project uses Semantic Versioning (semver), with versions in the form MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH. A MAJOR bump signals breaking changes, a MINOR bump signals backward-compatible new features, and a PATCH bump signals backward-compatible bug fixes, so users can judge compatibility and decide whether to upgrade from the version number alone.
EOF
cat docs/policies/version-scheme.md
